lossManifest.detail: SP native text uses bold 750 or normal 400 and generic SVG uses 700/400; source weights remain in source mapping.

SP native renderer quotes the whole fontFamily string, so source CSS fallback stack cannot safely be passed as a single family. Primary family retained; no fonts embedded or installed; device fallback unverified.

lossManifest.handling: source DOM measured; SP typography unverified
lossManifest.detail: Source rendered text boxes and line breaks reconciled to actual browser DOM. SP native font availability, font weight quantization, baseline and clipping remain unverified.
RGBA surfaces/lines are composited on disclosed flat slide background; gradient and optical blending are not preserved.
Generic SVG uses Arial, ignores text alignment, custom line height, some stroke widths and native roundRect. Adapter validation is not visual validation.
Two source 620×620 ambient circles with blur(130px) and opacity .1 omitted.
Two source 620×620 ambient circles with blur(130px) and opacity .1 omitted.

2 canonical objects have width/height below 2 target pixels. Pinned native objectNode clamps rendered boxes to at least 2 px, so hairlines may become thicker. Canonical fractional geometry is retained; no product code is changed.

limitations: Generic framework preview only; the authoritative editor adapter is not integrated.
Plain multiline text and system fonts; rich text, custom fonts, crop, groups, arbitrary SVG and complex charts are unsupported.
Basic rectangles, ellipses, lines/connectors, raster images, plain tables and bar charts only.
